clips.text: Use dreaming consciously as meditation and know well that conscious dreaming opens new doors of perception.
Lie down, relax, and dream, but do not fall asleep; remain conscious in the background.
Wait and watch; dream anything that happens to your mind.
Do not plan beforehand - dream anything, because in dream the whole world is yours.
Dream your existence as you please; dream and be content... content with your dreams because they are yours.
And remember that nothing can be yours like your dreams are because you yourself are a dream entity! - and also because your wishes come to be true in your dreams, and only in your dreams.
But do not fall into identification.
